name: Mini golf, go-karts and laser tag

pf.license.need: where the state's rules require it: the business's registration, and a permit for the go-karts or the course where the state requires one; a portable course follows the same rules where they cover it
pf.license.ask: the business registration, and any state permit for the karts or the course with its last inspection date; the liability insurance certificate
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: goes live on identity and the registration; where the state requires a permit, only once it's on file
pf.license.renewals: permits and insurance reminded 30 and 7 days before; a lapse pauses new bookings
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance for the course, the karts and events at a customer's place, as the state or the venue asks
pf.license.staff: course hosts and kart marshals trained by the venue, with first-aid and CPR cards (certificates, not state licenses)
pf.license.background: background checks for hosts who work with children, where the venue or the rules require them

pf.services.shape: table: a course round is a space for an hour (up to 4 players); a party is a set time with a set number of players; go-karts and laser tag are added to a booking
pf.services.examples: the example venue's own prices (Lee Mini Golf, and Lee Party Greens for a portable course at a customer's place), not a standard

list.name: Mini golf round for 4 (18 holes)
list.capacity: a round starts every 15 minutes, up to 8 courses

list.name: Open round for 4, pay at the counter
Birthday party package, 12 kids, 2 hours
list.price: $180 for 12 kids; each extra kid $12, up to 20
list.kind: one price per party, with a minimum
list.length: 2 hours: a round for everyone, then 30 minutes in the party room
list.after: the $140 rest paid at the counter on the day, for the final count

list.name: Go-kart race, added to a booking
Portable 9-hole course, 3-hour party for 12
list.before: a $60 deposit once the booking is confirmed
list.after: the $240 rest charged to the saved card when the crew texts DONE

list.name: School carnival course, 2 hours (up to 20 kids)
list.before: a card saved for the $40 late-cancel fee
list.after: the bill texted after the event

list.name: Portable course, 1 hour at home (up to 6 players)
Extra hour on a portable course

pf.services.capacity: courses per start time, set by the number of courses and the venue's safety limit; a party room is a space for the party's time
pf.services.times: every 15 minutes inside the course's hours; same-day bookings until 1 hour before; up to 30 days ahead
pf.services.notBookings: walk-ins are the open rounds at the counter; food, arcade games and the snack bar are outside Rosie

beforeTimes: which round, party or portable course, and the date and time
how many players, and each one's age group (under 7, 7 to 17, or adult)
for a party: the expected number of guests
for a portable course: the kind of place (a yard, a school, a park) and the town
afterTime: the birthday child's first name, if the booker wants it used
anything staff should know to help (answers about health stay on the secure page)
securePage: a waiver for every player: an adult signs their own; a parent or legal guardian signs for each child
the waiver's health check: a heart condition, a recent surgery, or a back or neck problem (the answer stays on the secure page; kart drivers answer it too)
the party's guest list (first names only), and an emergency contact
for a portable course: the street address and a flat area about 40 by 60 feet
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult (18 or over) books for a group; a parent or guardian books for a child; a child under 7 plays only with a paying adult on the course
pf.questions.told: players stay on the course paths and off the other courses; kart drivers meet the track's posted age and height limits; arrive 15 minutes early to check in

stop.words: someone hit by a kart, or a crash with someone hurt or bleeding, or someone choking or not breathing right now
stop.say: Call 911 now. Don't move someone with a head, neck or back injury.

stop.words: a child missing from the course or the party
stop.say: Call 911 now if the child can't be found at once. The host calls the parent and the manager.

goOn.words: a heart condition, a recent surgery, or a back or neck problem
goOn.what: the booking can go on for the others; the waiver says who shouldn't drive a kart; the person decides, and Rosie gives no health advice

pf.safety.atTheCourse: a player hurt on the course or a track: the host stops play, gives first aid, calls 911 when needed, and calls the parent at once if the parent isn't with them; an incident report goes on the secure page the same day; the owner is told
pf.safety.turnAway: anyone who seems drunk or high doesn't drive a kart or play that day; a player who ignores the track rules after a warning is asked to leave
pf.safety.weather: indoors: no weather limit; a portable course outdoors stops in lightning or high wind, as the crew decides

steps: a waiver for every player, signed on the secure page before the visit and good for 12 months; a parent signs for each child
the party's final headcount 3 days before (it sets the rest due)
a portable course: the customer confirms the flat area, any outlet the crew needs, and any permission the place needs, 3 days before
pf.first_steps.prep: comfortable shoes; a jacket for an evening round; arrive 15 minutes early

pf.visit.checkIn: at the front desk: the booker's code for the group; the desk sees which players have a waiver on file, and each one gets a scorecard and a ball and putter set; the host checks the party in
pf.visit.lateEntry: a round is timed by the course; a late group joins the next round if one is free, or gets the time left
pf.visit.missing: a player without a waiver signs on the desk tablet (a parent for a child) before playing; only that player waits
pf.visit.changes: extra players on the day are added at the per-player price if a course is free; the booker says yes first
pf.visit.children: a child under 7 plays only with a paying adult on the course; a 7 to 17 year old's parent signs the waiver
pf.visit.done: the desk's check-in confirms the visit; the host texts DONE at the end of the party; the crew texts DONE after takedown

pf.money.before: rounds paid in full when booking; a party's $40 deposit; open rounds nothing before; a portable course's $60 deposit for a party
pf.money.after: a party's $140 rest at the counter for the final count; open rounds at the counter; a portable party's $240 rest charged to the saved card when the crew texts DONE; a school course's bill texted after
pf.money.cancel: a round: a full refund if moved or cancelled 2 hours or more before; a late cancel or no-show keeps $12. A party: free to cancel up to 7 days before; later the $40 deposit may be kept, only with the owner's yes. A portable party keeps its $60 deposit on a late cancel, with the owner's yes
pf.money.membership: none: no monthly membership is sold through Rosie
pf.money.tips: a tip for the host on the venue's own reader, the business's own way; Rosie never asks
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies: one $2 per booking, however many players
pf.money.noSale: food, snacks, arcade games and merchandise are outside Rosie

pf.messages.never: children's names, ages and health answers, and injury details: only on the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: the host's day list shows the booker's name and the number of players; the guest list opens on the secure page
pf.messages.minors: texts go to the parent who booked, never to a child

pf.staff.licenses: none from the state; first-aid and CPR cards for hosts and marshals, tracked by the venue
pf.staff.skills: course host, kart marshal, party host, portable course crew
pf.staff.ratio: one host per 6 players at a time, as the venue's safety plan sets; a portable course always has 2 crew
pf.staff.standIn: any trained host or crew member; nobody is booked by name
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs refunds, party changes and anything over $500

pf.rules.waiver: no player on a course or a kart without a signed waiver; a child's waiver signed only by a parent or legal guardian
pf.rules.courses: one group per hole at a time; players stay on the paths; the course's own rules as the venue posts them
pf.rules.ages: a child under 7 plays with a paying adult on the course; kart drivers meet the track's posted age and height limits, checked by the staff at the track (never by Rosie)
pf.rules.alcohol: no kart driving after drinks: anyone who has been drinking doesn't drive or play that day; any drink service follows the venue's own rule and is never a Rosie step
pf.rules.inspections: the venue's daily course and kart checks, and the state's inspections where its rules require them
pf.rules.records: waivers kept as long as the insurer requires, and with the booking for 7 years; incident reports kept with the booking
pf.rules.cancelRight: no cancel period for course time already given
pf.rules.reviews: a rating once after the visit, never after an injury

pf.edges.headcount: the party's final headcount 3 days before sets the rest; more on the day are added if a course has room; fewer than 10 on a party still pay for 10
pf.edges.injury: a player hurt: first aid, 911 if needed, the parent called at once, an incident report the same day; no rating asked after it
pf.edges.noWaiver: a player without a waiver signs at the desk before playing; only that player waits
pf.edges.impaired: a player who seems drunk or high doesn't play or drive; the rest of the group plays; no refund for that person
pf.edges.closed: a power cut or a course problem closes the venue: new times or a full refund
pf.edges.wind: a portable course: the crew stops in lightning or high wind; time lost to weather comes back as a partial refund or a new date
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

Flow A (the group comes to Lee Mini Golf): a round for 4 on the course, $48 paid in full when booking, $12 kept on a late cancel or no-show (main); a birthday party for 12 kids, $180: $40 deposit when booking, $140 rest paid at the counter for the final count, $40 kept; an open round for 4, nothing taken, the bill at the counter. Flow B (Lee Party Greens comes to the customer): a portable 9-hole course for a 3-hour party for 12, $300: $60 deposit, $240 rest charged to the saved card when the crew texts DONE, $60 kept (main); a school carnival course for up to 20 kids, 2 hours, $180: a card saved for the $40 late-cancel fee, the bill texted after; a 1-hour portable course at home for up to 6, $90 paid in full, $20 kept. Services (two per flow): A a-add 'Go-kart race, added to a booking' $20 (card, counter), a-full 'Mini golf round for 4' $48 paid in full; B b-add 'Extra hour on a portable course' $60 (card, bill), b-full 'Portable course, 1 hour at home' $90 paid in full. Who may book: an adult (18 or over) books for a group; a child under 7 plays only with a paying adult on the course; kart drivers meet the track's posted age and height limits, checked by the staff at the track (never by Rosie). No kart driving after drinks. Safety: a kart crash with someone hurt, bleeding badly, choking or not breathing = 911, no booking; a child missing from the course or the party = 911 if not found at once. The danger examples in B3-11, B3-18, B3-19 and the flood example are rewritten for a course. Licenses: D96 (the lookup branches off in S1-60 and S2-28; registration and insurance shown as given, never checked). $2 on every booking (D97). Settings: set start times in both flows; cutoff 24 hours before (A), 2 days before (B). Money B limited to set-start times (money.B.booking). Names: Lee Mini Golf (flow A, 270 Harbor Rd), Lee Party Greens (flow B), hosts Gus and Mo (A), crew Tess and Ray (B); customer Alex M. The master's price-change, discount and rate examples are number-free or use this venue's own rows (the discount example is a percentage). Plans, classes, stages, bank transfer, sent-now and drop-off are off; the plan-only branches stay hidden by the plans fact.
